verdicts.reason: A: SOLSTICE sits below the headline and is blown up almost to headline weight. The two badges are enlarged until they match or beat the 'Find It Near You' CTA and bury it. A leftover piece of the green circle collides with the 'Summer Only' badge in the bottom-left, and there is dead space above the headline. B: also oversized: SOLSTICE runs edge to edge, the headline nearly touches the right edge, the 'Back by Demand' badge is wider than the CTA, and the same stray circle sits behind 'Summer Only' at the bottom. B is slightly less bad because the phone-first top-to-bottom order suits a skyscraper and the badges compete less with the CTA.
